intro: Every task entering this stage gets one approval per row, and cannot move forward until each is approved or waived. Any Developer can decide; the label says whose call it is.
key_title: Identifier, lowercase [a-z0-9_]. Left empty, it comes from the label
reset_title: An agent run that leaves new commits in this stage puts the approval back to pending
types_title: Task types this approval applies to. None ticked = every task
on_changes_title: What happens when someone requests changes on one of these approvals

on_changes.resume: resume the agent with the feedback

errors.label: Approval "{key}" needs a label
errors.key: Approval key "{key}" must be lowercase [a-z0-9_], up to 32 characters
